summary: 1920x720 digital instrument cluster for Qt 5.15 (C++ host, embedded-gpu): speedometer and tachometer dials, telltales, navigation, trip and media cards.
common: Project runs offscreen (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen) with zero QML warnings or errors.
No web engine, WebView or screenshot image embedded as a background; the UI is built from Qt Quick items.
All colors, font sizes, spacing and radii come from a Theme singleton; no raw hex or pixel literals elsewhere (production mode).
Fonts are bundled under assets/fonts and loaded by scanning the folder; QML uses the family names returned by QFontDatabase.
All visible text matches golden-spec text[].string verbatim, including Turkish characters (ç ğ ı İ ö ş ü) and uppercase transforms.
Repeated patterns listed in golden-spec nodes[].model are generated from a model (Repeater/ListView/GridView/TableView), not copy-pasted items.
Interactive controls are keyboard reachable and expose Accessible.role/name.
README lists every value whose source is not 'truth'-equivalent (assumed/low confidence) and every approximation with its reason.
mustHave: Qt 5.15 dialect: versioned imports, QtGraphicalEffects instead of MultiEffect, no Qt 6-only types or properties (qt5.py check is clean); a C++ host (CMake, Qt5) that builds against Qt 5.15.
Two 270-degree dials drawn as vectors (Shape arcs) from the 135-degree start: track, value arc and needle bound to a speed (87 of 240) and an rpm (2.4 of 8) property, not baked in.
Tick marks and scale labels generated from the scale (13 speed labels, 9 rpm labels, minor ticks), placed on circles; the rpm redline from 6.5 drawn in red (track segment, ticks, '7' and '8').
Big '87' and 'D' in Rajdhani Bold, 'km/sa', the 90 speed-limit sign, the P R N D selector from a model with D selected and the ECO chip.
Telltales from a model of 6 (2 on: green lights, amber engine; 4 off in the dim color) and the two turn arrows (left on, right off).
Navigation card: maneuver icon tile, '350 m', 'Atatürk Bulvarı', progress at 0.62, 3 route items.
Trip tiles from a model of 3 with uppercase labels keeping the Turkish İ ('MENZİL', 'ORT. TÜKETİM'); media card; fuel (6 of 10) and coolant (5 of 10) segment bars from models; odometer line.
niceToHave: Needle and arc animate between values (Behavior on the bound property).
Lit segment counts bound to fuel and coolant levels.
allowedApproximations: Dial arcs with round instead of butt caps.
forbidden: Qt 6-only QML (MultiEffect, VectorImage, per-corner radius, versionless imports).
A raster image of a dial or of the input.
Blur or shadow effects (embedded-gpu flat cluster).
